title: Mixed Event — Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show! — Episode6 A Place To Relax And A Night Melody

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!
meta.Episode: Episode6 — A Place To Relax And A Night Melody
meta.Event Outline: After successfully wrapping up their ambassadorial performances, Wonderlands×Showtime is preparing to put on a New Year's show at the new and improved Wonder Stage. Unfortunately, Lion Dance Robot seems to be feeling a bit under the weather...

rows.Line: Noon
Shrine

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
...is about how it goes.
Were you able to see what we just did, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Y-Yeah, I was. Thanks...
So this is how you make a wish...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Now we just need to draw our fortunes. Would you all mind drawing them for us?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Fortunes...?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So... They're supposed to show how lucky you're going to be this year... Or something along those lines.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I see...
That's exciting. You get to know how lucky you are right here...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The reasons they give are usually pretty hokey...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Right.
Whether or not you believe this stuff is up to you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, don't rain on our parade like that! At the very least, I believe what's written, and I think this is really fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, we're at the shrine office!
Mafuyu, you draw Len's fortune♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why me...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because I've got a feeling that you have the best chance of drawing a “great blessing”. I mean, just look at Ena. She's totally a “small blessing” person.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's that supposed to mean?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay, fine.
I'll draw for him...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Th-Thanks...
If you could please, Mafuyu...!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone's taking this so seriously...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have a feeling that we have another good year ahead of us.
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, I still can't believe you actually drew a “great blessing”!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I know, right?
But Len seemed happy, so I'm pretty glad.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But mine ended up being a “curse”...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
D-Don't worry...!
That happens to all of us sometimes!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I-I'm so sorry, Mafuyu...!
You must've used up all your luck when you drew that “great blessing” for me...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay. I don't put much stock into these.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right.
I also drew a “curse”, so it could just mean that they're the most common.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <O-Okay, I hope you're right...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Mizuki, we came all this way because you said there's something you wanted to see. Can you tell us what?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Excellent question!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The thing is, there's an accessory shop that's having a sale right now only! So, I wanna go check it out!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're kidding, right?
That's totally just something you want to do!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, there's stuff for all of us!
It's New Year's, so we should dress up a little! Right, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I don't really mind, but...
I'm not sure how much I'll use those kinds of accessories...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That piano over there...
Isn't that the one we played after Shibuya Festa?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh?
What makes you think that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The cover for the keys has a little moon on it. I noticed it when we played that time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
It is that piano.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Cool, so it's been here this whole time!
I didn't notice it at all!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Me neither.
This means we just have to come here whenever we want to play it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh?
A bunch of people are gathering over there...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: D-Didn't we see them perform during Shibuya Festa...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's Tsukasa and his troupe!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow! I didn't know they were doing a show here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They're doing a show...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wah! Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
M-Miku, no.
People are gonna see you if you pop out like that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Sorry...
I was a little curious is all...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...
In that case, why don't you watch while trying to stay hidden?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are you sure...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
Let's watch it together, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“*Sob*
Were these past ten years all for naught...?”

rows.Speaker: Lion-Dog
rows.Line:
“Please cheer up, Tsukasanosuke!
Your castle... I can't really do anything about that...”

rows.Speaker: Lion-Dog
rows.Line: “But I had a lot of fun these past ten years thanks to you.”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (He spent ten years putting smiles on people's faces with his performances. I can't even begin to imagine what that must've been like.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(As hard as it probably was...
I'd like to think that he had a lot of fun.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <He's like you, Kanade...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh?
Like me...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Because you're also doing your best to make others smile.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess so, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shapeshifting Fox
rows.Line:
“And those smiles we saw...
That became our treasure.”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Smiles became their treasure...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I see...
Seeing Mafuyu smile did make me really happy...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, look...!
I think Tsukasa's gonna go apologize to the Lion.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sounds like a happy ending to me.
I mean, the background music sort of says it all.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I agree.
This song's so gentle... And beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Did the music just stop...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh oh. Are they having some technical difficulties?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I charged her on our way over here, but... Robo-Nene might not be handling the sudden change in climate all that well...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Constantly moving between a cold, outdoor area and a warm car may not have been the best idea...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hm? Where'd the music go?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Is it over already...?
Talk about a half-baked ending...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, what are they gonna do about this...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What do we do? Do we keep going without the music? But if we want this scene to still feel sentimental...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I have to try...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“What in the world...?!
We were just about to celebrate! We cannot do that without music!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “It was the reason I was able to muster up the courage to apologize to the Lion Dance Deity. Can anyone out there play something for us?!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“...
Is there no one out there?!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, they're in trouble...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: This seems pretty over. Wanna go check out some shops...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(This was such a good scene too...
The music suddenly stopping really ruined the mood...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I wish I could help...
But playing in front of all these people...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, Kanade...!
Where are you going?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Is this it...?!
Do we have no other choice but to go back to our original plan...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(...?!
The music! How...?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (T-That...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That person... She's Akiyama's friend...!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I only got to hear it for a second, and that was just one part...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But based on that scene, I think this was how it was supposed to go...!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Huh? The music's back!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Someone's playing live!
Cool...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What a turn of events...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Someone from the audience has decided to help us! We mustn't let their efforts go to waste!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“What a splendid sound...
I feel greatly encouraged already.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Now, where were we...?
I apologize for calling you a liar, my friend.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “I already knew that you had given me something incredibly precious.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “So, thank you. For everything.”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Deity
rows.Line: “CHOMP...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I can't thank you enough!
I greatly appreciate what you did for us back there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Um, miss...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh... My name is Kanade Yoisaki.
It's just... I was playing before I even realized what I was doing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Shibuya Festa and now today.
Your friends have been helping us out quite a lot lately, Mizuki. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heehee♪
Isn't Kanade a great pianist?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Nicely done, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, you really had me scared for a second there! But the song you played was so beautiful and heartwarming!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Indeed it was.
It's incredible how you were able to improvise such a warm and gentle melody. After hearing that song for the very first time no less...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your performance was beyond wonderful, and it helped me get back into character. So, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Everyone!
We need to head back to the Wonder Stage soon!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
It's already time...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It is noon.
We should get going.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone!
Back to Sis's car!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Mizuki, everyone, thank you very much.
We wish you all a Happy New Year.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, uh. Yes.
Happy New Year.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Bye, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. That ended up being more energizing than I was expecting. And I got to hear Kanade play live.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What? I didn't do anything special...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it was...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! I mean, you're probably one of the only people who can come up with a song like that on the spot!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you all very much...
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
At last!
We're finally back!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
That was incredible, everyone!
I can't believe you put on all those shows today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, we couldn't have done it without you! So, thank you very much for what you did today!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
All I did was drive you around, but...
You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, thank goodness we were granted permission to perform at each of those locations.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I know they were short, but I really wasn't expecting to spend New Year's Day doing all these shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Wasn't it fun to perform at all those different places☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, it was.
Not only was it fun...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was a wonderful learning experience!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
So, let's take what we learned and put it to use for our grand finale!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
A grand show to bring in the new year!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP!
